d: Anil Ambani 2008 men duniya ke chhathe sabse amir aadmi the, apne bare bhaee Mukesh Ambani se sirph ek arab dolar pichhe, aur 2020 men London ki kort men unki taraph se kaha gaya ki unki net worth zero hai. is documentary men shubhankar mishra batate hain ki Ambani bhaiyon ka bantvara kaise huaa, aur Reliance Power IPO, MTN deal, KG gas ki laraee, RCom aur Jio, Ericsson kes, chini bainkon ka kes, Big Cinemas, Mumbai ki bijli, Reliance Naval aur Reliance Capital ke bikne se lekar ED, CBI aur SEBI ki janch tak Anil Ambani ka downfall kaise huaa, aur kya sach men Mukesh Ambani ne Anil Ambani…
